newsitem.title: GERMANY: Prodi optimistic on smoothing telecoms hurdles.
newsitem.headline: Prodi optimistic on smoothing telecoms hurdles.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi indicated he was optimistic on the possibility of overcoming opposition from the hard-left Communist Refoundation party on privatising state telecoms holding Stet.
"In March, (legislation for) a controlling authority on communications will go to parliament," Prodi said at a news conference on a visit to Germany.

Asked if there would be problems with Communist Refoundation, which guarantees a government majority in the lower house of parliament, he said: "I can't go into details but I am confident that things will go ahead."
Communist Refoundation opposes the full privatisation of Stet.

Stet, which is due to merge with state operator Telecom Italia by June, is due to be privatised this autumn. However its privatisation has been repeatedly put off in the past due to the blockage in parliament of legislation to create a sector watchdog after privatisation.
